repeat_policy.clock: sender-side time.perf_counter_ns around synchronous production batch_transfer_sync; CUDA synchronized before and after the timed call
repeat_policy.curve_replica_policy: median across repeats per direction; maximum across directions; then maximum across two frozen placement replicas; never select the faster direction or replica
repeat_policy.data_validation: outside timed intervals, verify every byte in the transferred payload on the receiver GPU for both directions and every payload knot
repeat_policy.interpolation: piecewise linear over log2(payload_bytes) using unsmoothed physical knots; no extrapolation claim outside each model's measured payload support
repeat_policy.raw_storage: all per-iteration records remain in Git-external JSONL; Git stores only compact knots, audits, hashes and variance diagnostics
